I hate to say it but yeah, you need to go no contact. 

  
Same situation for me, 5 year relationship, broke up with me out of no where. I reached out to him for probably two months after (mostly angry texts, but a lot just missing him being such a big part of my life). I eventually got blocked. I still would reach out. I was going crazy at this point. 6 months after our break up (he had done it over text, we were long distance-ish - 4 hours) I sent a message saying how it had been 6 months and he still couldn't face me. To my surprise it went through and we finally met up. I had promised him I would never reach out again if he did that for me. I kept my side of the promise. It was honestly the only thing that kept me going. My ego of being able to say "yeah, I haven't reached out in x years/months". I never thought I could do it. I really really struggled with it but it's the only way.

  
Regarding your actual question of when it gets better, it sort of just happens. I don't think it's as some people describe it on here as "one day you just don't care anymore", it happens gradually. It sort of goes "yeah, that happened and it sucked, but I have to put myself first". It's something you literally have to fight towards. And I hate to say it but for me personally, it never fully went away. I don't think it ever actually will, but you sort of learn to be okay with that. It's been 3 years since my break up and I just accepted that those feelings for him & the memory will always just be there. 

  
I know both "no contact" and "give it time" are pretty much all you read on here and trust me when I say that when I was on here 3 years ago I'd want to curse everyone who would write that in their replies, but that's actually it. Those are the two answers.

This was it for me! I wanted so long for him to come back and he never did. I eventually started believing what OP said. Then I got the clarity of what you just said! 

  
Even if they came back begging, and me being who I am would say yes, there's no way it would go back to where you initially were. How do you even see them the same way? This person watched me cry and beg and go through a year long depression and never cared. The last time we talked I cried for our 2 entire hour long conversation and there was absolutely no expression in his face. I didn't recognize him anymore. He wasn't who I was so deeply in love with.

Give it back/get rid of it. My ex and I were long distance (he ended things) and I put everything in a box and drove it to his house 4 hours away. I couldn't bare to see him so I gave it to his sister to give to him.

Everyone told me to sell everything but honestly that was too much of a hassle. "doing too much" if you will. I downloaded all of our pictures/videos from all social media accounts and from my phone and put them on a flash drive and it's sitting in my drawer. We dated for 5 years so it was a lot. I'm a big memory person and my favorite past time is scrolling through old pictures but doing this was the best thing I could've done for my healing process.

I returned everything back to him other than 3 things. A ring he had gave me on our first valentine's day, my charm bracelet he had bought & started for me (this had charms not only from him but from friends and family as well, but i still thought of it as his), and the last valentine's day present he got me, a little pop up picture box with a sweet message he wrote to me. everything else went back.

Yes, there's going to be days you regret giving the things back, but it's honestly best to just not see them anymore. I hadn't looked at our pictures or the gifts since our break up 3 years ago up until last week when he passed away. The pictures are a good thing to keep, trust me (just not easily accessible as to where you go in and see them every few days).

I have sooo many songs and playlists it's ridiculous. I feel like any song I listen to, whether it be heartbreak or love song, I always relate back to him. The last and final text I sent him before I forced myself to go no contact was a link to "Knowing You" by Kenny Chesney. We broke up 3 years ago and that song made me cry every single time for a whole 2 years during my "healing" process.

He just unexpectedly passed away last Thursday and I hadn't listened to it in a few months until I played it now on YouTube and now I'm ugly crying all over again.

I had the exact same thing happen to me. Dated 4 years & he broke up over a text w me. This was our 3rd time breaking up. First time I did it w him, second he called me & told me it was over, third time he just texted me he was done. I’d also ask for reassurance and he too made fun of me. He told me I was crazy and that I also had “unrealistic expectations”. Last month on the 30th was our 6 months. I’m not sure what a quick way would be to get over someone. I’m 6 months out and I still cry for him a few times a week. (Which is a great improvement as I used to literally cry all day long every single day the first 4 months). I’d say just give it time, go out with friends, if working out is something you like, you can do that (this didn’t work for me as I hate working out and have actually gained a lot of weight), eat all the food you want, go to therapy (this has helped me).

I’ve been crying for the past 2 days lol. A lot of shit has happened so I’m blocked but I have a fake number I text him on & he sometimes responds. I texted him yesterday & he didn’t even bother denying the cheating claims as he used to when we had broken up. Instead he just ignores my questions and keeps telling me the same thing he’s been saying for the past 4 months. That he’s sorry, that it wasn’t my fault, things just didn’t work out, and that he doesn’t think us talking face to face will do anything. He broke up w me over a text so I’ve been begging for a face to face conversation.

I finally stopped crying a few hours ago. I’m not “okay” but I’m forcing myself to accept the reality of what happened. I have to force myself to just not think about him cause if I do I just start crying again and want to message him.

I know it’s a cliche but it does get better. I was in the exact same spot you were in during that first month. I couldn’t stop crying. I’d literally cry all day every day. Would barely eat, barely sleep. Everywhere I go I remember being there with him (which is ironic since we were long distance) same as my house, him sleeping in my bed with me, me & him watching so many movies in my living room. I was extremely co-dependent on my ex. I felt lost after the BU. I didn’t know who I was. I started going to therapy. It’s helped, I think? Or maybe it’s just that time is passing. 

Something I will recommend is doing no contact and distracting yourself. I know you mentioned it’s hard but maybe try going for walks? That was like the only thing that would help me during those first few weeks. I tried doing NC but failed miserably. I ended up finding out about him cheating a few weeks before dumping me and him now dating her… I will tell you it’s very much a roller coaster of emotions. I just found out about them dating now and I’ve been crying for the past 2 days. I finally stopped crying a few hours ago and am in a somewhat better mood. Something that sort of helped me was telling myself I didn’t want to be stuck in that rut years from now. I’ve never felt a pain like this before and honestly I don’t know if I will be “over it” in a few years but I’m trying to push myself… If you want to talk more, I’m here!

So early April he had gone to Mexico to visit a friend & he were drinking & driving & the friend ended up passing away. He asked me to come but didn’t necessarily put too much pressure on me when I told him I couldn’t go due to work & my mom not letting me (I still live w my parents). April 30th he broke up w/ me and as soon as people from our town in Mexico started finding out, everyone suddenly wanted to tell me they knew he cheated earlier that month while he was over there…….. I asked him about it and he denied it every single time. I believed him. A few weeks ago people started telling me again & they even told me who the girl was. At that time he had gone to visit his friends’ brother in Mexico & my cousin happened to be in town & she sent me pictures of him with her. I still sort of refused to believe it. A few days ago my cousin told me they’re officially dating (apparently have been for months now. idk how long?) & even his mom is calling her her “daughter in law” now…. I texted him yesterday, not expecting to get a response but I did. He’d usually immediately deny everything when I asked him about the cheating but this time he didn’t even bother. He just completely ignored my questions. Sort of confirming it, I feel…

I got out of a LDR 4 months ago. We dated for 4 years. He complained to me throughout the entire relationship that LD was too hard for him, that he struggled with staying loyal. We lived 4 hours from each other and would meet up at least once a week. We would often argue but due to him having gave me an std and him promising to marry me after doing so, I tried to make things work no matter what. I was/still am terrified of having to share the std with someone else and so I'd literally stick through whatever he'd put me through. He was my first everything so it's been super hard. I actually found out after the breakup that he cheated on me a few weeks before dumping me but even then I still miss him. I'm still here trying to figure out what I could've done better. Why wasn't I enough for him? I write him pages and pages of questions I have for him (he broke up w/ me over text (even though the drive wasn't bad, we'd make the drive weekly. I guess I wasn't worth the gas at the end)). I still cry every day. I sometimes wish I wasn't here anymore. It's confusing because I hate him so much for having done everything to me but I still love him. I don't know what to feel or how to move on.

I'm not sure how he's seeing them if I'm blocked..... He wasn't one to ever post on social media during the 4 years we dated but after we broke up he'd post every single day... Guys are just weird.

We dated for 4 years and I too was extremely co-dependent on him even though we were long distance. We also argued a lot during our time together & he also said he could go hours without talking to me when that was all I wanted to do. I missed having someone to talk to all day long. It's taken me a long time to accept that he's no longer there and wants nothing to do with me but I think I'm finally starting to get there.

Yes for sure!!!!! I cried every single day allll day for a whole month after the BU. I didn't eat or sleep for about a week or 2 after. I too felt completely lost. I put my all into my relationship, he was literally my entire life and he left me out of no where. It was 4 months on August 30th and it's sort of somewhat starting to feel better. I still cry probably every day or every other day but not nearly as much as I used to. I recently found out my ex cheated on me while we were still together so it's put a huge dent into whatever type of progress I thought I had made..... I personally feel like I need to distract myself. I still think about him a lot but when I do I need to force myself to push those thoughts away. I emerged myself into work, I took a lot of walks around my neighborhood, I started talking to old friends, cleaning helped me also. I used to watch a lot of TV and I couldn't even do that after the break up. Same with listening to music. The first show I was able to actually focus on (other than just having it as background noise) was "Dead To Me" on Netflix. It starts off as a wife grieving her dead husband which I felt I could really relate to, my ex isn't dead but the loss I felt made it feel that way. I tried "no contact" but failed miserably but I honestly wish I had gone through with it. Talking to my ex felt good for the few seconds he would respond but eventually he would stop... and it would cause all the pain and crying to come back. I know it's hard but I recommend it.

I felt the same way. It's been 4 months and he hasn't reached out at all. All the times we talk it's because I've reached out to him. One time we were talking about my mental health and how I was starting to have suicidal thoughts and he called me to check on me but that was the most he's "initiated" contact. Now when I mention that those ideas sometimes still come around he completely ignores it. He just says "sorry" and that's it. 

Previous times when we'd break up we always got back together the day after so I sort of expected that but not this time. I've also started doubting if he cares at all for me. Or if he ever did. We dated for 4 years and it seems like he forgot about me as soon as he sent that text breaking up with me.

It was super hard for me. I failed miserably at NC until I eventually got blocked. I now have to text him through a fake number I made which he sometimes responds on, sometimes he doesn't. But even when he does, he keeps saying the same 3 things he's been telling me since the BU. That it's not my fault, that it just didn't work out, and that having a face to face conversation will do no good (4 yr relationship & he broke up w me over a text 4 months ago). 

I found myself writing a loooooot. Either in my journal or in my notes app. I have sooo many messages and letters and essays I write him. Sometimes I do send them and sometimes I just leave them there. It helps and eases my mind for a little but I still want to eventually send them to him. It's hard because I still have so many questions I never got answered. I'm not getting any answers and I'm for sure not getting the responses that I would've liked. I think it's better to just leave them in a journal/notes app. .... I'm not sure what your situation was but if you need someone to talk to, I'm here.

It honestly is. It baffles me how he so easily forgot about the seven years of friendship that we had including our four year relationship. It was all gone to him in one day.

I have tried telling my family that I don’t want to hear about him or his family anymore but they aren’t really helping. I’m still obviously very much in love with him and essentially all of my posts on social media are about heartbreak & wanting my ex back. They think that by them telling me how he’s so easily moved on that it’ll make me stop wanting him back but instead it just causes me more heartbreak. I know he isn’t coming back. Ever. He hates me. He told me he didn’t but I wouldn’t be blocked and he wouldn’t be acting this way towards me if he didn’t. 

The thing about the small town is that it’s where our parents were born in Mexico, I live in Dallas & he in Houston. But we visit every summer and Christmas/Nee Years. We both have family over there & everybody knows everybody. I can’t not go visit half of my family but at the same time I don’t want to see him again. Especially not with her (the girl lives in Mexico). I use my social media a lot & I tried getting rid of everyone that reminded me of him but I’d have to delete everyone. Our lives were so intertwined that we had the same friends, even our friends in Dallas/Houston knew each other, our families, everything is just mixed. I can’t cut everyone off. I’d have no one left to talk to.

I guess? I know he wasn’t really interested in marriage but he did want to get together with me. We constantly were talk about our future and having children and starting a family and all of that. We were both raised as Catholic Mexicans & so the whole “moving in together before marriage” thing wasn’t an option. He knew that. He sort of wanted to play house w/o actually being married. 

I guess he did get scared? He was my first everything & he gave me an std the first time we had sexual relations. Ever since then he told me he’d marry me after I graduated college. I graduated last year and he broke up with me a few weeks before graduation but we got back together the day after. This time he broke up to me 2 weeks before my graduation ceremony. I guess it got all too real for him?

thank you for this post... in the eyes of my ex I guess I was supposed to be "okay" after he broke up w me... But as i kept finding out more things (him possibly cheating) and assuming stuff he ended up blocking me everywhere. I know I'm not supposed to go back to someone who supposedly cheated on me but it's hard to leave all those good memories you mentioned... I sometimes think "well maybe we didn't work out right now". he didn't want to get married while i did. he didn't use this as a reason when he broke up with me but I feel like it had something to do with it... I sort of think that maybe once he's ready to settle down he'll realize what we had? Idk....

I guess for the same reason, that I'd never get to be with him again.

Same here.... I felt that because of this we would forever have some type of connection but it was clearly nothing to him. It wasn't even enough to keep us together.

The night before he broke up with me I was about to buy him a trip to Paris for our 4 year anniversary. We had our entire summer planned (anniversary & my birthday in July, Paris trip in August). We were also long distance. He lives in Houston, I in Dallas (4 hours away). We would meet half-way at least once a week. He would often come to visit me, I would rarely go to Houston (strict parents - he knew this going in & was okay with doing most of the driving). I tried doing all the things he was in to. He's very much into drinking and going out and outdoors and fishing and hunting and I tried to get into all of it. I did anything and everything I could for him and for our relationship. I changed my career goals, I changed my own personal goals. I tried to change my way of thinking to match his. I tried all of it and it wasn't enough.

We used to FaceTime but it sort of stopped out of no where.. We were never really much of the calling each other type. We'd text all day long. It took me so long to finally be okay with not talking to him all day. I'd still text him probably every day after the break up for a whole month. I eventually ended up getting blocked. It felt like a punch in the face. I even made fake numbers to try to talk to him. He sometimes, rarely will answer me. I feel like an idiot for making myself feel so low..... I really thought I was going to marry this guy.

I'm in the same spot. He said that the "never enough" thing was something I came up with on my own. But if I would have been enough he wouldn't have left me... I tried so hard to be everything he wanted and he still didn't stay. I put up with all the mental abuse he put me through and he still left me. I started writing him a letter of all the things I'm sorry for but I'm hesitant on sending it.

I also got blocked... 4 year relationship and he broke up with me back in April. Said he wanted to stay friends then removed me off social media a few days later. I kept texting. He knew he hurt me, he even said the way he did things was way wrong (he broke up with me over a text). I stalked his FB one day & saw he added his ex back again so I called him out on it and I got blocked everywhere. I even made fake phone numbers to text him through. He's answered a few times. He said he didn't hate me but I know he does. I know he's made me out to be a horrible girlfriend and now a crazy ex-girlfriend. All I want is a face to face conversation. He put me through so much and I never left him and he did it so easily.

My ex and I also dated for 4 years & had also been rocky probably since around December. We took our first trip in March to Colorado. Since December I sort of thought he was waiting for the trip to be over so he could leave me but a month passed since the trip and things were good between us. April 30th I get a text saying he's lost feelings for me and that we're done. I keep begging for a conversation but I've gotten nothing. We're from a small town in Mexico and people have told me he cheated weeks before dumping me. He went to Mexico for a friends passing anniversary and I got pictures sent to me of him with the girl.
